notes: Partition verified: 24 source and 33 target ids each used once across 24 units.
s005 takes *against* under rule 16's first family: subtraction leaves *utter my judgments them*, so only the object relation is diminished and no other morpheme licenses the word.
*in that* is one connective rendering of אֲשֶׁר under rule 30, headed on *that* by rule 24.
*their own* belongs whole to the suffix under rule 18's emphatic-possessive clause, headed on *their*, with the rectum's *of* discontinuous around it.
s015's head is defensible either way; the unit note takes the lexeme as sitting in *burned* rather than reading *burned incense* as light verb plus complement.
